subject: Big Endian: add daily workflow UT job and fix UTs (#3330)
reason: The change is purely CI and unit-test work: it adds an s390x (big-endian) daily GitHub Actions job, adds/fixes gtest unit tests for endianness round-trips and raw byte layouts, and adds header prototypes (encodeTimeoutKey, decodeTimeoutKey, streamEncodeID) for functions whose definitions in timeout.c and t_stream.c are unchanged. No production code path, command behavior, reply, replication, persistence, or tool behavior is modified, so there is nothing for a fuzzer scenario to exercise.
